decision: Owner rung 37 (2026-11-11): normal TALON stands 37 px; Solar follows by the skull rule.
method:
TALON in-level rescale to the owner-approved 37 px rung (31 -> 37).

Route 1: re-reduce from the raw generation with the frame's original recorded method (cell crop,
aspect-safe pad to the native box, LANCZOS, indexed palette, 1 px inside outline), at the native
box scaled by 37/31, then re-apply recorded post-reduction rules. Each route-1 frame is validated by
reducing the same raw at the old box: if that does not reproduce the installed pixels (agreement
below AGREE), the frame carries an unrecorded edit and is routed to route 2 instead.
Route 2: Scale2x x3 of the approved pixels (an 8x smooth master), reduced with the same method at
the new box: uniform 1 px outlines, no uneven row/column doubling.
Plain: Scale2x x3 then nearest to the new box (shown only for comparison).
Feet and hotspot stay fixed: the hotspot keeps its distance above the sole scaled by 37/31.
anchors:
Anchors: the sole keeps its distance below the hotspot for grounded, rolling and flying frames (feet
on the ground, carry shoes where MICA grips); hanging and carried poses keep their top (the hands on
the bar or carrier); object poses scale about the hotspot. Slopes are re-derived from the rescaled
flats at the replaced frames' support distance. Writes PNGs, frames.yaml hotspots, recipe.json
native_pixels and production/talon/rescale-37.json (route and reason per frame). argv[1] = repo.
